text:
sam.devex: Quick user report from onboarding: different sample apps use REDWOOD_API_KEY, the CLI emits REDWOOD_TOKEN, and our Docker examples show REDWOOD_KEY. New devs are confused. anyone want to own a consolidation plan?

anya.sdk: I can own SDK side. I'd prefer we pick one canonical var and add clear fallback order. My vote: REDWOOD_API_KEY as canonical.

mohit.security: +1. compliance prefers explicit, unambiguous names. Recommend REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_ORG, REDWOOD_PROJECT. We should also ensure deprecation warnings when aliases are used.

ben.sre: operational constraint: a lot of infra automation still injects REDWOOD_TOKEN in CI. We need a migration recipe for CI and a small compat window. Also avoid silently switching precedence during deployment.

sam.devex: proposed precedence (for docs and sample apps): 1) explicit constructor arg, 2) REDWOOD_API_KEY, 3) legacy aliases (REDWOOD_TOKEN, REDWOOD_KEY) for N releases with warning, 4) ~/.redwood/credentials, 5) metadata service. Keep that in sync across CLI, SDKs, and sample apps.

anya.sdk: Implementation details: SDKs will: - read explicit arg > env > config file > metadata - if alias env var present, log a single WARN at init: "DEPRECATION: use REDWOOD_API_KEY; REDWOOD_TOKEN will be removed in X.Y" - if multiple sources found and values differ, emit WARN and prefer explicit arg > REDWOOD_API_KEY > file.

mohit.security: rotation and retry policy notes: - Short-lived tokens: provide refresh callback to SDKs; SDKs should attempt one automatic reload + retry on 401. - Long-lived tokens: require manual rotate via API. - Never log secrets in errors; only hint where to set them.

ben.sre: to avoid thundering herd during rotation: SDK default retry after reload should use exponential backoff with jitter. Default policy example: attempts=2, base=250ms, jitter=150ms. Expose policy override.

sam.devex: sample-app tasks: update all .env.example files to REDWOOD_API_KEY + REDWOOD_PROJECT, add "credential precedence" section to README, include tiny migration script that scans local .env for aliases and offers to rename (opt-in).

anya.sdk: I'll add an onAuthFailure(callback) hook so apps can implement custom refresh flows. Also will add a small helper: Redwood.normalizeCredentials() that returns { source, value, keyName } so dev tools can render helpful messages without leaking secrets.

mohit.security: perfect. ensure normalizeCredentials never prints value in logs, only keyName and source. Also add tests asserting stacktraces don't include environment values for missing creds.

migrator-bot: notice: teams with tokens older than 90 days will receive a migration reminder in #security on Monday.

ben.sre: CI migration plan: provide GitHub Actions snippet that maps secret REDWOOD_API_KEY to env REDWOOD_API_KEY, and a small script for build owners to rename secrets in repo settings. We'll keep REDWOOD_TOKEN alias for two releases and add deprecation warning to CI logs.

sam.devex: can we add example snippet for recommended container env? e.g. ``
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_live_xxx
export REDWOOD_PROJECT=service-a
``
include in READMEs.

anya.sdk: Will also include deprecation timeline in PRs: 2 minor releases with WARN, then 1 major where we drop alias. Opening PRs for node/python today.

mohit.security: final ask: add telemetry event when SDK encounters deprecation alias (no value), and an opt-out env var REDWOOD_DX_TELEMETRY=false for customers. Keep events minimal (alias_used:true).

ben.sre: noted. I'll coordinate rollout with infra so we don't surprise infra teams.

sam.devex: Great. Action items: anya opens SDK PRs; ben updates CLI + CI recipes; mohit adds security tests and telemetry opt-out; sam updates sample apps + migration script. Reopen if blockers. :white_check_mark:
